title: AutonomousWork Task Front Matter
description: Validates the YAML front matter of projects/<project-id>/tasks/<TASK-ID>.md files.

id.description: Task ID. Globally unique across all projects. Must match file name <id>.md.

priority.description: Machine-readable priority. Higher number = execute first. Suggested range 0-1000.

status.description: Execution state. Only 'ready' tasks (with dependencies done) are executable.

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must be done before this task is eligible.
